psychological_meaning: Wasabi green evokes feelings of freshness, naturalness, and a subtle spiciness, akin to the condiment itself. It represents a balance between energy and tranquility, suggesting growth, health, and a connection to the earth. It can also imply a unique and somewhat unconventional perspective.

wellness: Spa treatments focused on natural ingredients
